title: Mexican Chile Verde Stew: Slow Cooked
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 2.3333x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%. Serving anchor: 6 source servings -> 14.

ruled_substitutions.ruling: olive oil (first-printed option); lard not taken

ruled_substitutions.source: 3 pounds pork shoulder or chuck roast
ruled_substitutions.ruling: pork shoulder (first-printed option and the title protein of a CHILE VERDE); standing canon maps 'pork shoulder' -> Pork Shoulder

ruled_substitutions.source: 1 tablespoon cumin seeds or 1 teaspoon dried cumin
ruled_substitutions.ruling: the printed ALTERNATIVE (1 tsp dried/ground cumin) is taken because Ground Cumin is the stocked vocab row; Cumin Seeds has no row (vocab exit 3, nearest rows are different seed foods). Not a guess: the author printed the equivalence herself.

ruled_substitutions.source: 2-3 green chiles mild or medium- I used 1 Anaheim and 2 poblanos
ruled_substitutions.ruling: booked as 3 poblanos: the author's own stated mix is majority poblano, the printed range allows 3, Poblano Peppers is a stocked vocab row and board commodity (4 of 7 stores), and Anaheim has no row. Same product class and price class (mild fresh green chile, both $3-5/lb retail), so this is not a variety-pricing stretch; NOT mapped to Diced Green Chiles (canned form-flip, standing rejection class).

registrar_rulings.mapper_sweep_evidence: ingredient-vocab exit 3 GENUINE GAP (no row shares a core word); price-ingredient verdict ABSENT ('no board cell and nothing in any capture matches'). NOT mapped to Chili Powder (a cumin/oregano/paprika BLEND, different food) and NOT Smoked Paprika (different pepper) - both would be the plausible-wrong-match failure the vocab tool warns about. macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS - protein -11.1% is inside tolerance and the main protein is weight-anchored by the source (3 lb stated), so no portion re-examination is triggered. The gap direction is the familiar raw-basis-vs-lean-record split: identical 227 g raw pork per serving on both sides, but their calculator evidently booked a leaner pork record (47 P from 227 g raw implies 20.7 P/100 g vs USDA lean-and-fat 17.4) which also explains our +6 g fat and +13% calories. Carbs 13.7 vs 11 is densities-scale rounding on the vegetable lines.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 533.7 cal in [400, 650] PASS (134 above floor, 116 of ceiling headroom); carbs 13.7 g <= 35 PASS. Chipotle line booked zero pending its DB row; ceiling of that omission ~1.5 cal/serving, not band-relevant. No optional macro lines.

loud_flags: Chipotle Powder is the recipe's only unresolved line: vocab gap + board ABSENT + no label to transcribe, so it ships bid-null with ZERO booked macros (ceiling ~1.5 cal/serving). Recipe parks in 'pricing' on that single blocking term; everything else answered from disk.
The stew's two broth lines quantize to 2 1/4 cups each; the page's own 'add more if needed / to thin' discretion is not booked.

yellow onion: Baker's cell is 'Jumbo Sweet Onions' and Fareway's is 'Vidalia Onion' - sweet-onion varieties priced inside the yellow-onion commodity; same aisle and price class but noted for the gate.
